title: Siam-ALS: An Explainable Siamese Deep Learning Framework for Early ALS Detection Using EEG and Eye-Tracking Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.15351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) diagnosis remains challenging due to heterogeneous symptoms and reliance on clinical assessment, underscoring the need for objective, data-driven approaches that leverage patient-generated physiological signals. We propose Siam-ALS, an explainable Siamese deep learning framework that jointly models synchronized electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking (ET) signals. EEG captures ALS-related changes in brain activity, while ET provides information about oculomotor control, allowing the model to learn complementary patterns associated with ALS. The framework employs two modality-specific encoders: a convolutional EEG encoder that captures spatiotemporal neural patterns and an MLP-based ET encoder that models oculomotor dynamics. translated_title: Siam-ALS：一个基于脑电图与眼动追踪信号进行肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）早期检测的可解释孪生深度学习框架
translated_abstract: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的诊断仍然具有挑战性，原因在于其症状具有异质性且依赖于临床评估，这凸显了对能够利用患者自身生理信号的客观、数据驱动方法的需求。我们提出了Siam-ALS，这是一个可解释的孪生深度学习框架，可对同步采集的脑电图（EEG）和眼动追踪（ET）信号进行联合建模。EEG能够捕捉与ALS相关的大脑活动变化，而ET则提供眼动控制方面的信息，使模型能够学习与ALS相关的互补模式。该框架采用两个模态专用编码器：一个用于捕捉时空神经模式的卷积EEG编码器，以及一个用于建模眼动动力学的基于多层感知机（MLP）的ET编码器。这些模态特定特征经过权重共享的孪生分支处理，并融合为一个紧凑的64维联合嵌入，随后由一个轻量级分类器……
tldr: 本文提出Siam-ALS框架，通过可解释的孪生深度学习联合建模脑电图与眼动追踪信号，利用两个模态专用编码器提取互补特征并融合为联合嵌入，从而实现ALS的早期客观检测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Siam-ALS, an explainable Siamese deep learning framework that jointly models EEG and eye-tracking signals through modality-specific encoders fused into a joint embedding, enabling early and objective ALS detection.
